description: Fibocom L850-GL / L860-GL (Intel XMM 7360/7560), USB MBIM: family base, never matched itself. ModemManager owns it (its XMM support speaks MBIM); QModem does not list the family. Radio over AT is the XMM dialect: AT+XACT mode/bands (LTE as 100+band, the band tail kept on a mode change), AT+XLEC aggregation, write-only at@sic:freq_lock cell lock with CFUN=4 / CFUN=15 around it (docs/modem-zoo/modems/fibocom-l850-l860.md)

radio.source: another modem manager 3.2.2 L850/L860 profiles; Telegram field notes (CFUN=15 after freq_lock on L860-GL-16 fw 18601)
